h1b: Now every one of them rings to you.
tagline: Coastal Crown already has the part most contractors never get right — real before-and-after proof, a clean brand, and a quote flyer that closes. The gap is what happens after someone picks up the phone. We put a 20-line Smart-DID grid behind the brand, deliberately covering both partner territories: 10 lines on the Restoration Royalties combo (786·400) and 10 on the FAST Adjusting combo (645·231). Every house wash, driveway, roof, pool deck and fence call is answered instantly, in the caller's language, and routed to the nearest crew — and storm leads move across all three brands instead of dying in a voicemail box.
demoNote: Coastal Crown Pressure Washing · Serving South Florida · 20-line dual-territory pack · numbers pending assignment
insight: a pressure-washing job runs $250–$8,000+ — and the difference between a driveway and a full commercial contract is which line the caller dialed. Coastal Crown's own flyer proves the work; the caller is standing outside looking at the stain with the card in hand. But every one of those calls lands on a single untracked cell number — so there is no way to know which flyer, sign, or post produced the job, and no answer when the crew is already on a roof.
